purpose: Teach: 検挙/記帳/投書/動議/募っ/危惧し/横ばい/雑多

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界不祥事の、本気で、絶対、検挙、絶対、警察と、絶対、連携しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need absolute commitment on this: industry misconduct has to be reported to police. No exceptions. Make it happen.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding tone. Plant each phrase firmly. No warmth — this is non-negotiable. Level eye contact. Pause just slightly before the final directive for weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の、本気で、絶対、記帳、絶対、迅速に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Accounting records will be processed swiftly and thoroughly. We're on it.
lines.style: Steady, attentive. Measured delivery — not rushed, but demonstrating forward momentum. Respectful posture in the voice. A slight nod at 'swiftly' to show he's tracking the priority.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様からの、本気で、絶対、投書、絶対、真摯に、絶対、受け止めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Customer complaints must be taken seriously and handled with genuine care. That's the standard.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Emphasis on 'seriously' — not a lecture, more a restatement of what matters. Steady pacing. The tone of someone setting an expectation he knows his team understands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。株主総会、本気で、絶対、動議、絶対、対応、絶対、準備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're preparing a full response for the shareholder meeting, including motions on all outstanding issues.
lines.style: Professional, composed. Speaks with quiet confidence — no hesitation. Even pacing throughout. The tone of someone reporting solid work in progress.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規採用に向け、本気で、絶対、人材を、絶対、募って、絶対、いるぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We're actively recruiting new talent. I want strong candidates in the pipeline, and I want it moving now.
lines.style: Direct and energized. A slight rise on 'actively' — this is something happening. Not impatient, but urgent. The rhythm of someone pushing forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の、本気で、絶対、不正、絶対、当社、絶対、危惧して、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're closely monitoring industry irregularities and assessing any risks to the company. Nothing will catch us off guard.
lines.style: Careful, measured. The voice of someone thinking while speaking — picking words with precision. Alert but controlled. A subtle emphasis on 'monitoring' to signal vigilance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、本気で、絶対、横ばい、絶対、状態、絶対、打破せよ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Performance has plateaued. I need us to break through that. New strategy, new approach — whatever it takes.
lines.style: Authoritative with an undercurrent of frustration. Emphasis lands on 'plateaued' and 'break through.' Slightly faster tempo — the urgency of someone who sees stagnation as unacceptable. Decisive final phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。雑多、本気で、絶対、な業務、絶対、整理、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Acknowledged. We're consolidating processes and streamlining operations to clear the way for what matters most.
lines.style: Closing cadence. Calm and methodical — the voice of someone wrapping up with confidence. Slightly more air and space between phrases. The tone of 'we have things in hand.'
